note: Hotel facts re-read from official pages on 2026-11-17. Every value carries the official URL and the verbatim excerpt it was read from. A field with no official source is null and flagged; nothing is inferred. Room rates are dynamic and live in rates_log.json as dated snapshots, not here.

tax.scope: Combined transient lodging tax for a resort hotel within the primary gaming corridor (Las Vegas / unincorporated Clark County)
tax.components: 12.5% base transient lodging tax + 0.88% stadium district tax
tax.excerpt: Resort hotel within primary gaming corridor | 12.5% | 0.88% | 13.38%
tax.effective: New combined rates effective on March 1, 2017, as stated in the ordinance
tax.caveat: The ordinance states the rates 'may be subject to change by the applicable jurisdictions'. The current tax actually charged is shown on the official booking page and on your folio; confirm there before relying on a total.
